title: Nietzsche in German, 1876–1895: the books as printed in his lifetime, with Götzen-Dämmerung and Ecce homo as transcriptions

license.payload: Public domain in the United States: every item was first published in 1930 or earlier, and every author died more than seventy years ago (Spinoza 1677, Leibniz 1716, Nietzsche 1900, Bergson 1941, Kafka 1924, Artaud 1948). items.work: Friedrich Nietzsche, Die Geburt der Tragödie. Oder: Griechenthum und Pessimismus. Neue Ausgabe mit dem Versuch einer Selbstkritik (Leipzig: E. W. Fritzsch, [1886]) — the new edition of the book of 1872, with its 'Attempt at a Self-Criticism'; Google Books scan (the Archive dates it 1872; the title page and the preface give the new edition)

Menschliches, Allzumenschliches: Ein Buch für freie Geister, Zweite Auflage (Leipzig: C. G. Naumann, 1894) — both volumes; University of Michigan copy, Google Books scan
Morgenröthe: Gedanken über die moralischen Vorurtheile (Leipzig: E. W. Fritzsch, 1887) — the new edition, with the preface of 1886; New York Public Library copy, Google Books scan

Also sprach Zarathustra: Ein Buch für Alle und Keinen, Vierte Auflage (Leipzig: C. G. Naumann, 1895) — the four parts together; Harvard University copy, Google Books scan

scope: The books as printed in Nietzsche's lifetime, each held as the scan of the copy found and named by its own title page: Die Geburt der Tragödie in the new edition with the Versuch einer Selbstkritik (1886), Richard Wagner in Bayreuth (1876), Menschliches, Allzumenschliches (1894), Morgenröthe (1887), Die fröhliche Wissenschaft with the fifth book (1887), Jenseits von Gut und Böse (1886), Zur Genealogie der Moral (1892) and Also sprach Zarathustra (1895); and Project Gutenberg transcriptions of six works, Götzen-Dämmerung (1889) and Ecce homo (1908) among them. QUEUED: the first editions of Die Geburt der Tragödie (1872), Die fröhliche Wissenschaft (1882) and Zarathustra's four parts (1883–1885) as scans; the other Unzeitgemässe Betrachtungen; Der Fall Wagner, Der Antichrist, Nietzsche contra Wagner; the Nachlass. Not seated: Der Wille zur Macht, Elisabeth Förster-Nietzsche's compilation from the Nachlass; the Colli–Montinari edition and its digital form, under their publishers' terms.

why_seated: MANUS, 27 October 2026, after the twenty-sixth seating: "deleuze and guattari... no way around that copyright, huh?" Told that every route through it is closed for decades, and offered a declared absence for them and the open sources they read: "yes - i cant believe we havent seated spinoza yet. yes to all" — and "and leibniz' monodology only". Nietzsche is seated as the source of Deleuze's Nietzsche et la philosophie (1962), the book with which Deleuze's reading of the eternal return and the will to power begins.
ruling: Seated in the language each wrote in, as far as the public domain of the United States reaches and an open witness was found, beside the declared absence of Deleuze and Guattari (27/07) (MANUS, 2026-10-27).
